entry.description: Turn supplied statements into contrasting constructs and a traceable means-ends map. A basic cognitive-mapping rehearsal. It is not a full negotiated SODA intervention and does not turn participants' causal beliefs into established facts.

key_distinctions: Mechanical correctness is distinct from judgement in an open situation.

practice_connections: Construct four short concepts with meaningful contrasts.
Connect means to ends and retain the tension.
Find a candidate option that connects the concerns.
